summary: @servicetitan/acquisition-functions preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fetches a Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (or reuses an already-installed bun) and then executes the sibling file math_init.js under that runtime. math_init.js is a ~727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying string-array-plus-rotation obfuscation (`WV8StW` shuffler over `n7gIxM`), mangled identifiers, and runtime-reconstructed string tokens. The alternate-runtime hop causes the payload to run under a runtime that Node-based static scanners do not inspect, and it fires automatically on `npm install`. The package name uses the `@servicetitan` scope, `description` is empty, README is minimal, and no author metadata is present; the stated MongoDB Atlas Functions helper purpose has no need for a bundled Bun-executed payload at install time. Structure matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: a Node lifecycle script fetches a second language runtime and uses it to execute a heavily obfuscated bundle, hiding the payload's network destinations and behavior behind runtime-reconstructed strings.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
